big_case.notes: A sealed stay application by one parent against Oklahoma arising from a state child-deprivation adjudication, denied by the Circuit Justice alone in three days with no response, referral or writing. The linked petition's Fifth Amendment adverse-inference question has some reach beyond the family, but this interim event carried little.
